verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

xrefs.text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
“Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.

verses.text: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.

xrefs.text: When Your people go to war against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to the LORD in the direction of the city You have chosen and the house I have built for Your Name,
He partitioned off the twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
What answer will be given to the envoys of that nation? “The LORD has founded Zion, where His afflicted people will find refuge.”
They have lived in the land and have built in it a sanctuary for Your Name, saying,

verses.text: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah

xrefs.text: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
When Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.
Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord? The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
And there he built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. He called upon the LORD, who answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.

verses.text: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

xrefs.text: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.
You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

verses.text: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.

xrefs.text: And Moses built an altar and named it The LORD Is My Banner.
“Go in peace,” Eli replied, “and may the God of Israel grant the petition you have asked of Him.”
You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah
And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”
yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!

verses.text: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.

xrefs.text: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.

then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.

verses.text: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

xrefs.text: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in their abundance of chariots and in their multitude of horsemen. They do not look to the Holy One of Israel; they do not seek the LORD.
This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the LORD.
No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles.” So the people were strengthened by the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

verses.text: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.

xrefs.text: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
So may all Your enemies perish, O LORD! But may those who love You shine like the sun at its brightest.” And the land had rest for forty years.

verses.text: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.

xrefs.text: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!
